description.value: House of Lager is a craft brewery in Squamish, BC, dedicated exclusively to the art of lagering — a style the founders describe as underestimated but rewarding. Born in 2020 as a side project under House of Funk Brewing, it has evolved into a standalone taproom destination on the shores of Squamish where mountains meet the ocean. The taproom hosts events and weddings and is open seven days a week, making it a natural stop for cyclists exploring the Sea-to-Sky corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an active brewery taproom in Squamish with a full menu, reservations, and events — clearly open and publicly accessible. The OSM phone number (+1-604-715-4258) differs from the website footer number ((604) 567-9148), so I use the website value and flag the discrepancy. The website does not mention bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or most other amenities, so those remain null per absence-of-evidence rules.
concerns: Phone number mismatch: OSM has +1-604-715-4258 but website footer shows (604) 567-9148. Website value used.
OSM name is 'House of Lager Eatery' but the business consistently brands itself as 'House of Lager Brewing Company' on its website — 'Eatery' does not appear anywhere on the site.
Website contains two conflicting sets of operating hours on the same page (different Saturday and Sunday open times), suggesting the page may be partially outdated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active brewery taproom open seven days a week in central Squamish — a prime stop for Sea-to-Sky touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: The website lists 'ORDER DELIVERY' as a navigation option, suggesting off-premise ordering may be available, but explicit takeout confirmation is absent.

wow_evidence: standalone taproom destination on the shores of Squamish where mountains meet the ocean
